description: Web server and reverse proxy — service control, server blocks, proxy, SSL, cache and logs.

nginx-test.title: Test configuration
nginx-test.description: Checks the syntax of the configuration files without applying them. Always do this before reloading.

nginx-reload.title: Reload without downtime
nginx-reload.description: Gracefully reloads the configuration, without dropping active connections.
warnings: Run 'nginx -t' first; an invalid config prevents the reload.

nginx-stop.title: Stop the service
nginx-stop.description: Shuts Nginx down immediately. Use 'quit' for a graceful shutdown.
warnings: Interrupts serving requests; prefer 'nginx -s quit' to drain connections.

nginx-version.title: Version and modules
nginx-version.description: Shows the version, build flags and enabled modules (useful for diagnostics).

server-block.title: Basic server block
server-block.description: Minimal block that serves static files from a directory for a domain.

location-tryfiles.title: SPA fallback (try_files)
location-tryfiles.description: Serves the requested file or falls back to index.html — the standard for SPAs (React, Vue).

redirect-301.title: 301 redirect
redirect-301.description: Permanently redirects while preserving the requested path.

proxy-pass.title: Reverse proxy
proxy-pass.description: Forwards requests to a backend application (Node, etc.).

proxy-headers.title: Proxy headers
proxy-headers.description: Passes the host and the client's real IP to the backend, essential behind a proxy.

upstream.title: Load balancing (upstream)
upstream.description: Defines a group of backend servers for load balancing.

websocket-proxy.title: WebSocket proxy
websocket-proxy.description: Enables the connection upgrade needed to forward WebSockets.

ssl-cert.title: Configure TLS
ssl-cert.description: Enables HTTPS by pointing to the certificate and the private key.
warnings: The private key (.pem) must have restricted permissions and never be committed to version control.

force-https.title: Force HTTPS
force-https.description: Redirects all HTTP traffic to HTTPS.

gzip.title: gzip compression
gzip.description: Compresses text responses to reduce the transferred size.

expires-cache.title: Static asset caching
expires-cache.description: Sets long-lived cache headers for static files.

client-max-body.title: Upload limit
client-max-body.description: Sets the maximum request body size (uploads). The default is 1m.

rate-limit.title: Rate limiting
rate-limit.description: Defines a per-IP rate limiting zone; apply it with 'limit_req zone=api;'.
warnings: Limits that are too low can block legitimate users.

error-log-tail.title: Follow error logs
error-log-tail.description: Follows Nginx errors in real time — the first stop when diagnosing 502/504.

access-log.title: Configure access log
access-log.description: Sets the access log file. Use 'access_log off;' on noisy static locations.
